title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hi Anthony, I am back home in Detroit. I am not feeling to well as I am trying to get over this flu I got at the GM Meetings. If I feel better and you are around we can try to get together this weekend.
That sucks. Get some Airborne tablets. They’ve worked well for me. I’ll call you this weekend.
